description: Sets up Cosend’s “Lead follow-up” automation on one WhatsApp number: Each new lead from your lead form gets your WhatsApp message within seconds, and your AI receptionist answers their reply. Its settings are this recipe’s own, as its set-up form in Cosend asks them; a setting left out takes its default. It is set up switched off, and acts only once it is switched on. The same recipe is set up once on each number, or once per source when it asks for one. The preview refuses a second one as the save would, and gives no token. It needs  connected to the workspace first (by integration key). Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the automation, switched off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

name.description: Its name in Cosend. Left out, it takes the recipe’s name.

settings.description: The recipe’s settings, as its set-up form asks them. A setting left out takes its default; a setting with no default is needed.

fallback_language.description: Sent when the customer’s own language isn’t one of the message’s approved languages. Left empty, the message’s first approved language.
fallback_language.title: Fallback language

lead_ads.description: Your connected lead ads. Every new lead from their forms gets your message, as each form’s consent setting allows.
lead_ads.title: Lead forms

questions.description: When a lead replies, your AI receptionist asks these, one at a time, before it books or passes the chat to you.
questions.title: Questions for the AI receptionist

template.description: A message approved by WhatsApp, sent to each new lead within seconds. It fills in their name first.

components.text: Hi {{1}}, thank you for your request. Reply here with any question and we will help you right away.

template.title: First message
